judgment.rationale: Both are Performance Objectives in the same Primary Three 'Fractions' topic. The second (objective 1, 'state fraction of a group of concrete objects') is a foundational identification/recognition skill establishing the basic concept of a fraction, while the first (objective 3, 'write fractions which have the same value as a given fraction') requires understanding fractions well enough to represent equivalence. Proficiency in recognizing/stating fractions of concrete groups supports success in writing equivalent fractions, justifying a same-rank developmental direction from second to first based on the objective texts and their numbered ordering within the topic. Shared ancestry, page proximity, and token overlap alone were not treated as sufficient.
